directions.caution: You have not tried creators yet, so results may vary at first.
directions.plain: You send pieces to small creators who already dress like your customer. They post real wearing photos for you.
directions.title: Let creators show your pieces
directions.why_for_you: Your on-hand photos get the most love, and creator posts earn even more love in your data. Most seeded creators in your data do post.
directions.you_would_do: Send pieces to a few creators, message about ten to find them, and ask for on-hand wearing photos each week.

directions.plain: You pick a week with a small discount. You post every day that week to remind people.
directions.title: Run a simple sale week
directions.why_for_you: Sales lift buying a lot in your data, and last month you were close to your goal with no sale.
directions.you_would_do: Pick a week, choose a small discount on your best pieces, and post daily with on-hand photos.

directions.caution: You spent nothing last month, so we have no recent ad proof for you.
directions.plain: You pay to show your best photos to more women like your customer. It works fast and stops when you stop paying.
directions.title: Put money behind best photos
directions.why_for_you: Your on-hand close-ups already get the most love, so you have strong photos to boost.
directions.you_would_do: Pick two on-hand posts, put them in front of women your customer age, and post three times that week.

directions.plain: You post most days and spend nothing. Growth is slow but safe.
directions.title: Just post often and steady
directions.why_for_you: Last month you stayed close to your goal with no spend, but our check missed a few weeks so stay careful.
directions.you_would_do: Post four or five times each week using mostly on-hand photos and some close-ups.

season_note: November brings a little more shopping interest at 1.04 but ads cost more at 1.18 so favor your own posts and creators.
